notes.contentHtml:
This major has approved GE modification(s). See below for information on how to apply these modification(s).

  • CSCI/MATH 217 is an approved major course substitution for Critical Thinking (1B).


The following GE courses also meet major requirements:

  • MATH 105 - Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning (2)
  • ECON 103 - Social and Behavioral Sciences (4)

notes.content: A grade of C- or higher is required in all Computer Science (CSCI) courses used for the major. Each CSCI course may be attempted no more than three times each. After a third attempt with a grade below C- in any single required CSCI course, a student will not be able to complete the major.
